title: 0 Of 7 Brain Networks Supported The Personality Myth
hook: Scientists tested 7 brain networks. None supported the personality myth.
closing: Your brain collaborates across both sides, so personality cannot belong to one half.
question: Were you labeled left-brained or right-brained?

segments.say: Language is 96 percent left-sided for right-handers, but personality does not split that way.
Of 7 brain networks tested, 0 matched the left-brain, right-brain personality myth.
About 200 million nerve fibers connect the brain's halves, constantly sharing signals across both sides.
